svg.aria-label: 10 / 10 eval notes tagged right, Claude Haiku 5.5, 27 Oct 2026. USD 0.0001 per summary, metered on every call. 36 tests, end to end included, no key and no cost in CI. 4 projects it was extracted from, what they repeated, nothing more.
